create_variableclient: create a VariableClient instance with a VariableSource and TensorFlow variables mapping
update_variables_async: call update on VariableClient to periodically fetch and copy variables asynchronously
update_variables_blocking: call update with wait=True on VariableClient to block until variables are updated
update_and_wait_immediate: call update_and_wait on VariableClient to immediately fetch and copy variables from source
copy_variables: call the internal _copy method to assign new variable values to existing TensorFlow variables
